g.text: u spend a lot of time in that backroom.
how is my roguish perfectionist today?
You seem upset. Is it something I said?
Thanks for checking in. I'm doing fine.
our mysterious hero from the future! u doing well?
Thanks for checking in. I'm doing fine.
how are u today? not being too hard on urself, I hope
how is my fave time traveler?
I didn't love being called boring.
Cute. Lol. Okay, I admit it. I've had better days.
I don't think pinky swears work online.
Thanks for checking in. I'm doing fine.
Thanks for checking in. I'm doing fine.
Oh. I really didn't mean anything by it.
then swear on something important to u!
good I just wanted to make sure <3
Honest. I'm sorry I upset you.
You're not boring, Aoi. I just thought I was being clever.
If you were really boring, I wouldn't be talking to you.
anything I can do to make ur day better?
It seems the jury's convinced by your defense
You could tell me a joke.
Pretty lady like you? I can think of a few things. ;)
and grants you a fresh start
Okay, I confess. I've had better days.
Can't you just accept I'm fine?
Oh, I see Aoi's emoticons are back. I think that's a good sign.
a suspiciously curt answer but ok
med pack ur bags. we're going to the future!
hope u don't mind me getting a bit serious for a sec
I see u pushing yourself for others without ever asking for anything in return
so I just wanna say, if u ever want to share some those burdens u carry, I'm always here
I appreciate you saying that, Aoi. I'll keep it in mind.
You should deal with your own issues before trying to take on someone else's.
I bet you say that to everyone.
I don't think we can help ourselves without helping others too
only the people I care about
^_^ ok enough serious talk for now
but that's a topic for another time
